_about: Sheng and Swahili words FounderLink understands, used by ai/extraction/sheng.py.
Add a word only if you are sure what it means in everyday Nairobi Sheng, then add a test in ai/tests/test_sheng.py.
Keys are lower case. Values in 'words' are the plain Swahili or English word the rest of the AI already knows.

units._note: Words that multiply the number after them (Swahili order: 'elfu hamsini' = 50,000) or before them ('50 ngiri').

words._note: Sheng word -> the plain word the extractor and the scam check already understand.
